infra/sandbox/wasm_tools — WasmToolAdapter for go-busybox applets.

Wraps wasmtime execution of individual go-busybox applets as sandboxed tool calls. Each applet (grep, find, sed, cat, etc.) runs as an isolated WASM process with bounded filesystem access.

Usage: let adapter = newWasmToolAdapter() let result = adapter.runApplet("grep", @"-n", "pattern", "file.txt", "/workspace") if result.success: echo result.output
